item.title: President Pezeshkian: Iran not to bow to bullying, religions share commitment to justice

item.title: World is losing confidence in US financial system, says Araghchi
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has taken a jab at the US Treasury Secretary for his rhetoric about launching an economic war on Iran, saying Scott Bessent should look at his own failure to break the fever in the bond market amid eroding trust in the American financial system.

item.title: Grossi harms impartiality and independence of UN nuclear watchdog: Baqaei
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has criticized the head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) for his continued politically motivated and biased stance towards Iran’s peaceful nuclear program, warning that Rafael Grossi is squandering the credibility of the Agency.
